name: timestream-write
description: Amazon Timestream Write Amazon Timestream is a fast, scalable, fully managed time-series database service that makes it easy to store and analyze trillions of time-series data points per day.

subcommands.name: create-batch-load-task
subcommands.description: Creates a new Timestream batch load task.

subcommands.name: create-table
subcommands.description: Adds a new table to an existing database in your account.

subcommands.name: describe-batch-load-task
subcommands.description: Returns information about the batch load task, including configurations, mappings, progress, and other details.

subcommands.name: describe-database
subcommands.description: Returns information about the database, including the database name, time that the database was created, and the total number of tables found within the database.

subcommands.name: describe-endpoints
subcommands.description: Returns a list of available endpoints to make Timestream API calls against.

subcommands.name: describe-table
subcommands.description: Returns information about the table, including the table name, database name, retention duration of the memory store and the magnetic store.

subcommands.name: list-batch-load-tasks
subcommands.description: Provides a list of batch load tasks, along with the name, status, when the task is resumable until, and other details.

subcommands.name: list-databases
subcommands.description: Returns a list of your Timestream databases.

subcommands.name: list-tables
subcommands.description: Provides a list of tables, along with the name, status, and retention properties of each table.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags on a Timestream resource.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Associates a set of tags with a Timestream resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the association of tags from a Timestream resource.

subcommands.name: update-database
subcommands.description: Modifies the KMS key for an existing database.

subcommands.name: update-table
subcommands.description: Modifies the retention duration of the memory store and magnetic store for your Timestream table.

subcommands.name: write-records
subcommands.description: Enables you to write your time-series data into Timestream.
